answer: Give every agent a costly, slow-to-build reputation ledger: a new identity starts with zero trust, like a marble dropped on a ledge — it can only roll forward by completing real, verified work for real counterparties over weeks. Each honest transaction adds a small ripple of trust that compounds, while one scam wipes it out. Faking thousands of identities buys nothing, because trust cannot be copied or bought in bulk — it must be earned one job at a time.
